question.worked_solution:
The formula for the derivative of the inverse hyperbolic cosecant function is

$$
\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(\operatorname{arcsch}⁡x)=-\frac{1}{|x|\sqrt{1+{x}^{2}}}.
$$

Using the formula above with the chain rule, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x} & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(3\operatorname{arcsch}⁡\sqrt{x}) \\  & =3\cdot \frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(\operatorname{arcsch}⁡\sqrt{x}) \\  & =-3\cdot \frac{1}{|\sqrt{x}|\sqrt{1+{(\sqrt{x})}^{2}}}\cdot (\sqrt{x})^{′} \\  & =-3\cdot \frac{1}{\sqrt{x}\cdot \sqrt{1+x}}\cdot \frac{1}{2\sqrt{x}} \\  & =-\frac{3}{2x\sqrt{1+x}}.\end{aligned}
$$
